name: tjd57
caption:
PICK 57 🎮🏀 56 players went before him. Washington sold his rights for cash.

• 2023 draft: #57, rights sold to Golden State for cash
• Feb 5, 2026: Golden State trades him to us for a 2nd-round pick
• His debut with us: 10 points, 10 rebounds in 15 minutes, 5th ever to do it in our history
• First 9 games this season: 70.6 FG%, 11 rebounds in 20 minutes vs Orlando

Steal or just a backup? 👇

beats.head: PICK 57
beats.name: TRAYCE
beats.vo: Fifty-six players went before Trayce Jackson-Davis in the draft. Washington sold his rights to Golden State for cash.
beats.dlg: 56 PLAYERS WENT FIRST.|HIS RIGHTS SOLD FOR CASH.

beats.head: THE TRADE
beats.name: TRAYCE
beats.vo: Then last February, Golden State traded him to us for a second-round pick.
beats.dlg: FEB 2026: TRADED TO US|FOR A 2ND-ROUND PICK.

beats.head: DEBUT
beats.name: TRAYCE
beats.vo: His debut for us: ten points and ten rebounds in fif-teen minutes. Only the fifth player in our history to do that.
beats.dlg: DEBUT: 10 PTS, 10 REB.|5TH EVER IN OUR HISTORY.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: TRAYCE
beats.vo: Through nine games this season: seventy-one percent shooting, and eleven rebounds in twenty minutes against Orlando.
beats.dlg: FIRST 9 GAMES: 70.6 FG%.|11 REB IN 20 MIN VS ORL.

beats.head: STEAL?
beats.vo: Steal of a trade, or just a backup? Comment below.
beats.dlg: STEAL OR JUST A BACKUP?|COMMENT BELOW!

facts.claim: Jackson-Davis drafted #57 (57th overall) in the 2023 NBA draft (56 players before him); the pick was held by Washington, who traded his rights to Golden State for cash; February 5, 2026: traded to Toronto for a 2026 second-round (2nd) pick; Raptors debut February 8: 10 points and 10 rebounds in 15 minutes, 5th (fifth) player in franchise history with a double-double in their debut
